title: [todo:127] P1 v2：多轮记忆/偏好（history + summarization 策略）
P1: remove role fallback + strict log check + fix kimi timeout
description:
Problems observed in LangSmith + local traces:
1) main model (kimi-k2-thinking) frequently times out (APITimeoutError / httpx.ReadTimeout).
2) Errors were previously easy to miss; need server logs + test scripts to surface them and agents must fail if any exceptions occurred.
3) After main timeout, system falls back to moonshot-v1-8k (fast role) for command_gen/final; we want NO fallback for these paths.

Plan:
- Remove role fallback in API runtime (command_gen/final/load_llm_config); do not silently switch roles after failures/timeouts.
- Increase timeout for the main role (configurable) so kimi-k2-thinking can complete; aim for zero timeouts in acceptance.
- Make API acceptance gate strict by default: always scan logs/v2/run-<run_id>.jsonl for kind=exception and fail non-zero.
- Improve logging: when exceptions happen, print stack trace to standard logs (debug/trace enabled) without leaking secrets.
- Verify via API-only: ./scripts/v2_acceptance_api.sh (no UI). Confirm LangSmith shows runs for the new run_id and no role:fast fallback for command_gen/final.

Acceptance:
- ./scripts/v2_acceptance_api.sh passes with 0 exceptions.
- No command_gen/final calls tagged role:fast when main is requested.
- If any exception is recorded, acceptance fails and prints summary + points to trace file.
notes:
Analysis:
- kimi-k2-thinking (role=main) was hitting APITimeoutError at ~60s on command_gen/final; previously the runtime would silently fall back to fast (moonshot-v1-8k) for command_gen/final.

Fixes:
- Disabled role fallback in API runtime (no automatic switching roles after failures/timeouts).
- Added per-role timeout env: V2_LLM_TIMEOUT_S_<ROLE> (e.g. V2_LLM_TIMEOUT_S_MAIN).
- API acceptance is strict by default: scans logs/v2/run-<run_id>.jsonl for kind=exception and fails non-zero.
- Server logs now print exception stack traces when debug trace is enabled (ui_context.debug=true).

Verification (API only):
- Started API: API_PORT=3004 ./scripts/v2_api_dev.sh (3002 occupied locally)
- Ran: API_PORT=3004 ./scripts/v2_acceptance_api.sh
  - First attempt failed (strict): run_id=81853c71-6341-48a2-9cdc-7c28a8d97663 final[main] timed out; command_gen took ~59.7s.
  - After setting V2_LLM_TIMEOUT_S_MAIN=120, acceptance passed with 0 exceptions.
    Example run_id: b13a1a15-512e-454a-9e85-23d7a04de07f
- LangSmith check: for run_id=b13a1a15-512e-454a-9e85-23d7a04de07f, command_gen/final had role:main only (no role:fast fallback).

title: [todo:142] v2：默认主模型改为 kimi-k2-thinking；Intent 模型改为 moonshot-v1-8k（Moonshot API）
description:
## Goal
- Switch v2 default main model to `kimi-k2-thinking`.
- Use `moonshot-v1-8k` for intent / cheap ops (role `fast`).

## Endpoint
- Base URL: https://api.moonshot.cn/v1
- Chat Completions: POST /chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible)
- Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY`

Reference curl:
```bash
curl https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kimi-k2-thinking",
    "messages": [
      {"role":"system","content":"..."},
      {"role":"user","content":"..."}
    ],
    "temperature": 0.6
  }'
```

## Config plan (v2)
- Add Moonshot aliases in `LLM_MODEL_ALIASES_JSON`:
  - main: `kimi-k2-thinking`
  - fast(intent): `moonshot-v1-8k`
- Update `LLM_ROLE_BINDINGS_JSON`:
  - `main` -> Moonshot K2 Thinking alias
  - `fast` -> Moonshot v1 8k alias
- Ensure `V2_LLM_ROLE=main` and `V2_LLM_INTENT_ROLE=fast`.

## Acceptance
- Main command generation + final answer use `kimi-k2-thinking`.
- Intent classifier uses `moonshot-v1-8k`.
- Update `.env.example` and `docs/env.example.md` to include `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` and the new aliases/role bindings.
- Smoke test: `./scripts/v2_dev.sh`, send one draw request and confirm server logs show the expected model IDs for intent + main.
notes: - 默认模型切到 Moonshot（main=kimi-k2-thinking；fast/intent=moonshot-v1-8k；baseURL=https://api.moonshot.cn/v1；新增 MOONSHOT_API_KEY / V2_LLM_INTENT_ROLE=fast）\n- 自测：cd apps/api && uv run python -m compileall app；npm --prefix apps/web run build
close_reason: Implemented Moonshot default model config + docs
